title: Pubnet ledger 28489743: PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND_NO_ISSUER with its asset payload (Protocol 12)
why: PathPaymentStrictSend was added in Protocol 12 and its NO_ISSUER code removed in 13 (CAP-30), so the arm exists in ledgers of a single protocol. Like its strict-receive sibling it carries the Asset whose issuer is missing; readers that treat failure arms as void misread it.
notes: Chosen with the locate index of the full pubnet scan (token `T|arm|PathPaymentStrictSendResult::PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND_NO_ISSUER`): among the ledgers that hold the shape, the one with the smallest lake object. Header hash recomputed from the header and every transaction hash recomputed from its envelope at capture. `expect.values` are written by hand from the decoded sidecar; participants, state changes and movements are the reference extractor's output, checked against the sidecar.

values.note: The payload is the first of the two path assets.

must_not_include.because: named in the envelope of a failed transaction; only the fee payer and the source changed (candidate)
